sources.title: CellposeCellCounter wins Rep. Sarah Elfreth's 2025 Congressional App ...
sources.snippet: Rep. Sarah Elfreth has named Matthew Yang of Centennial High School as the winner of the 2025 Congressional App Challenge in Maryland's Third District. Their app CellposeCellCounter is an AI-driven microscopy analysis tool that automatically detects and counts cells in biological images.
